learner_operation: Read operation type, target and source row indices and scalar; swap whole rows or update every entry (including the constants column); for two operations use the updated intermediate matrix, then distinguish the matching option.

fixed_features.feature: Easy one swap/scaling, moderate one row addition, hard two sequential operations
fixed_features.justification: Observed workload in q-130070, q-130071, q-10217, q-130072 and q-72786. Keeps operation interpretation and arithmetic within source scope.

fixed_features.feature: Single radio response among five whole augmented matrices
fixed_features.justification: All 12 captured practice banks use this contract. Every entry including constants belongs to its row, per tutorial 3150.

fixed_features.feature: Three rows in easy practice; small signed integer inputs and compatible reciprocal factors
fixed_features.justification: Conservative source-grounded workload from q-130070 and q-130071. Matrix dimensions and exact values are not essential to the mathematical rule; the retained source q-10252 supplies the three-column scaling case.

fixed_features.feature: Exact source-only bank parameters for two uncertain historical distractor banks
fixed_features.justification: q-10252 contains an unusual distractor without a uniquely supported general construction. Guarded complete replay preserves evidence without replacing the existing freely varied scale/add practice families. The fixed source example is not sampled as a purported variable family.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All three unordered pairs in three-row matrices
answer_roles.observed: Fresh independent easy sample: 23 swaps, pairs [0,2]:14, [1,2]:6, [0,1]:3. Controlled same-input pair change alters result. Exact batch: two different matrices both request R1/R2.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any row; either scalar sign and bounded nonzero nonidentity integer/reciprocal factors
answer_roles.observed: 25 independent scales cover all three targets and 16 factors. Earlier bound-matched independent sample covered all 19 factors; current unchanged code retains them. Batch has R2/R1 targets and factors -5,-7,1/2.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Distinct donor/target; supported coefficients of either sign; updated intermediate row dependency
answer_roles.observed: Eight moderate and eight hard regression samples plus every supplied source profile; controlled coefficient changes for addition and both sequential templates.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five bank positions; UI reorders using question-field and item identity
answer_roles.observed: No fixed bank or UI position answers either delivered easy template. Delivered preview correct positions are [1,4,3,3,1]; source/control UI ordering checked directly from all HTML radio inputs.

coverage.case: Retained defect checks and added source-only profiles
coverage.result: Both strict checks fail on the preserved old package and pass current. Complete-bank equality, unique independently computed key and solution are checked; changed source-profile operands are rejected.

coverage.case: Independent easy sample before and after shared delivery filtering
coverage.result: 48 of 48 survive. All sampled row-pair/target/factor decision cases survive normalization, requested easy filtering and captured-inventory/within-batch deduplication.

Five of five survive. Two swaps share R1/R2; three scales use two targets and three factors. No tested fixed position or extreme-magnitude action solves either finite batch template. This batch alone does not cover all row roles.

Zero-row degenerate banks reject; forced initial zero matrices retry. Roles/scalars are selected outside entry resampling, so retries retain decision roles. One of 25 ordinary independent scales needed a second entry attempt.

coverage.case: Conditional learner selection from captured inventory and batch
coverage.result: Read-only model of the actual band-first SHA256 selection picks every batch item under positive easy-band weighting, with no exclusions and with captured questions previously seen. Within the eligible easy band selection is uniform. The no-weight configured fallback uses first eligible ID; no live policy/history was supplied.

counterfactuals.change: Keep matrix entries fixed and change swap pair, scalar, addition coefficient or second sequence coefficient; separately move scaling target
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt/interpretation, final matrix, correct answer and learner grading must follow the changed operation. The former matrix must be rejected when the result changes.
counterfactuals.observed: Six controlled changes across 17 total records change the exact computed result. Five coefficient/pair comparisons retain the same mathematical bank. Native grader tests every option before and after; full actual UI renderer includes all pairs.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial 3150 assigns every element of the named target row; source e-4694 and q-130071 show that row role/scalar are answer-bearing rather than incidental.

counterfactuals.change: Change only matrix letter in each of the five templates
counterfactuals.expected: Displayed name changes in prompt/solution while computed matrix and accepted mathematical choice remain the same.
counterfactuals.observed: All five renamings preserve independently computed results, complete mathematical banks and correctly graded responses despite regenerated UUIDs. Rendered prompts and solutions use the corresponding letter.
counterfactuals.justification: Source examples use A,M,N,T,U,V,X as matrix names without changing row-operation semantics.

delivery.result: No current sampled decision case is removed by delivery. Exact batch remains five records; raw and accepted coverage match. Actual DOM ordering of the five normalized batch records also has no fixed-position answer shortcut. Learner draws are conditional on positive easy weighting and item freshness.

limitations: Finite, targeted audit cannot prove absence of every shortcut. Unchanged sampling/engine evidence is reused with provenance rather than exhaustively re-audited.
Actual learner history, policy weights and future allocated item/entity IDs were not supplied. Selection and UI fixture observations do not predict an exact live next draw/layout.
Inventory basis 5361 is captured; later publication can change deduplication. No publication/preparation file currently exists, so shared read-only delivery filtering was used.

The exact batch has only two swaps and both request R1/R2. This is a limited finite practice sample; it does not establish all-pair coverage. Other row pairs occur in the unchanged general family and fresh controls.
Captured non-source inventory records lack generation provenance. No affected generated record was demonstrated for the two old omissions; no blanket absence of inventory defects is claimed.
q-10252 lacks captured key/solution/difficulty. Its key is inferred by exact row scaling; generated solution is authored and easy difficulty inferred. Canonical e-4694 has no captured bank.
